about.subtext1: ACC Academy — A specialized educational institute for executives and enterprises,
about.visionText2: , ACC harmoniously integrates modern in-depth knowledge and practical skills. Founded with dedication by educators and entrepreneurs, led by passionate young executives, our mission is
about.visionTextStrong2: to accompany and empower society through progressive, advanced education.
about.diffTextStrong1: deeply understanding and putting clients at the center
about.diffText2: , ACC delivers highly practical, immediately applicable programs taught by seasoned domain experts, practitioners, and visionary leaders with proven pedagogical methodologies.
about.coreValuesSubtitle: Three foundational pillars shaping mindset, action, and culture at ACC Academy
about.valueADesc: ACC emphasizes understanding oneself, learners, colleagues, enterprises, and the surrounding environment. Awareness is the starting point to expand thinking, recognize limitations, and explore new horizons.
valueAActions: Accurately understanding the needs of learners and enterprises.
Proactively recognizing personal strengths and areas for growth.
Open to constructive feedback and diverse perspectives.
about.valueC1Desc: ACC connects people with themselves, knowledge, experiences, community, and the world. Every authentic connection can open new lessons, opportunities, and pathways.
valueC1Actions: Connecting with sincerity, respect and integrity.
Connecting learners with instructors, experts and the community.
Collaborating and sharing to create value together.
about.valueChangeDesc: ACC does not regard imparting knowledge as the final destination. The true value of education is realized when what is learned changes mindset, action, and results, creating positive ripple effects for teams and organizations.
valueChangeActions: Learning must go hand-in-hand with immediate application.
Proactively driving change rather than waiting for circumstances to change.
Measuring educational value by tangible progress and actual outcomes.
about.manifestoQuote1: Markets are constantly changing. But the decisive factor lies not in current trends — but in the genuine internal competence of your organization.
about.manifestoQuote2: ACC Academy is a specialized educational institution for executives and enterprises, academically certified by Andrews University (USA).
about.manifestoQuoteStrong: We do not just sell courses. We build measurable competencies, accompanying your organization to real-world outcomes.
about.func1Desc: Customized in-house training for enterprises and practical capability programs for individuals.
about.func2Desc: Andrews MBA in Vietnam and GEI — Global Executive Leadership retreat in Michigan, USA.
about.why1Desc: Founded in 1874 — Andrews University is in the Top 10% of Best US Universities according to U.S. News, ranking 2nd nationwide in campus diversity.
about.why2Desc: All admissions, scholarship administration, and student advisory processes are unified through ACC.
about.why3Desc: Faculty combines Andrews professors and senior corporate executives currently leading prominent corporations.
about.why4Desc: Studying MBA — experiencing GEI — taking ACC programs: each step opens the gateway for executive career advancement.
about.leadershipSubtitle: Bringing together dedication, knowledge, and seasoned experience from visionary leaders and executives
